title: claude recent session
description: One element of claude:recent — an event log, capped: LPUSH on SessionEnd then LTRIM 0 19, so the list holds the 20 most recently ended Claude sessions across the fleet, newest first. On the central Redis since the CD-7 relocation; grandfathered shape (CD-3). Unlike the other two claude feeds this really is a JSON document, one per list element, so this schema describes it directly. A session ended with reason `clear` is deliberately not recorded — clearing a conversation is not finishing one. The writer owns the cap (rules.md): nothing else trims this list.

host.description: Host the session ran on; a value failing the host-token contract skips the record

project.description: Basename of the session's cwd; an empty project skips the record

title.description: Claude's session name as of SessionEnd. Empty when Claude never generated one — a short session is the normal case, not a fault

dur_s.description: Session duration in seconds; 0 means unknown, which is what a session whose start was never recorded reports

ts.description: Unix seconds (float) stamped by the publisher wrapper (rules.md)

x-counterexamples.why: the host token grammar admits no spaces; a host segment that cannot go in a key cannot go in a payload either
`project` has minLength 1 because it is what the row is labelled with — an empty one renders as a nameless entry
a negative duration means the two stamps were subtracted the wrong way round
`ended_ts` is what orders the log; without it the entry cannot be placed
